text.offer: Princess Kateriina says, "Akardius sits in Blackstone Keep and calls my throne his. It is time he learned otherwise. Say march to me when you are ready, and my army will meet you before Tos."
text.progress: Say "march" to your liege when you are ready. The army gathers at one of the city's outlying flagpoles two minutes later and fights when you arrive. If you never come, the siege fails. Win it, then return to your liege.
text.complete: Princess Kateriina says, "Tos held for a hundred years and broke in an afternoon. Barloque celebrates you tonight, Champion."
